subject: Follow-up: technical roadmap, timeline, and security/SSO intro
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@stellarnet.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: technical roadmap, timeline, and security/SSO intro

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the insightful discovery earlier today. Quick recap to make sure we captured the right priorities on our side: 
- Primary goal: surface-recommendations and generation at scale for the support knowledge base (expected 1–2M queries/month in year one).
- Data: customer support transcripts (PII redaction expected), some attachments.
- Requirements: sub-200ms tail latency for short responses, support for SSO + enterprise audit logs, and EU data residency considered later.

Next steps I propose:
1) A 60-min technical deep-dive (solutions + infra) to walk the PoC plan and SSO/network constraints
2) Loop in your security/SSO owner and procurement so we can surface any gating items upfront
3) Share a concise pre-read so the technical session focuses on gaps and success criteria

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 2/23 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2/24 09:00–10:00

Attendees we suggest:
- Evelyn Hart — Redwood (Account Exec)
- Karthik Iyer — Redwood (Solutions Engineer)
- Monica Patel — Redwood (Customer Success)

Can you confirm which window works and please loop in your security and procurement contacts (or I can loop them if you prefer)? I attached a short discovery summary for context.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwood.com]

[Attachment: Redwood_MVP-outline.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]
From: Samira Khan <skhan@stellarnet.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Lowe <plowe@stellarnet.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: technical roadmap, timeline, and security/SSO intro

Evelyn —

Appreciate the recap. That aligns with our internal read. We can do Tue 2/23 14:00–15:00 PT. I'm CC'ing Peter (security lead) — he'll handle SSO and audit controls questions. I'll also put procurement on notice; they prefer a single-threaded invite to attach contract questions.

A couple quick asks before the deep-dive:
- Could you share a 1–2 page pre-read that outlines the PoC scope and what success looks like?
- Any initial guidance on indicative pricing ranges for a 3–6 month PoC (ballpark numbers are fine)?

I'll confirm whether procurement will join the session; if not, they want an agenda and procurement playbook after the session.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Operations | StellarNet
skhan@stellarnet.com

Samira / Peter —

Great — locking in Tue 2/23 14:00–15:00 PT for the technical deep-dive. Karthik and Monica are on this thread now; Karthik will run the technical walkthrough.

Agenda (proposed, 60 min):
- 5m: introductions & goals
- 15m: current infra, traffic patterns, and latency/cost targets
- 20m: PoC architecture walkthrough (model choices, KV/prefix caching, SSO/auth integration options)
- 15m: outstanding gating items (network, egress, legal/procurement checklist)
- 5m: next steps and success criteria

Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMVPpreRead (short PoC outline + success metrics).

Attachments: Redwood_MVP-outline.pdf (brief PoC plan) — already sent. We can also provide an indicative pricing slide during the call; for initial planning we typically give a PoC estimate range rather than firm numbers.

Peter — on SSO: could you confirm if StellarNet prefers SAML2.0 (IdP initiated) or OIDC (preferred for platform integrations)? Karthik will bring a short SSO checklist to the call but wants to tailor it to your preference.

If procurement will not join the live call, we'll follow up with a 1-pager procurement packet and the HubSpot deal link after the session.

Evelyn
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

I've sent a calendar invite for Tue 2/23 14:00–15:00 PT. Quick technical pre-read attached and a short SSO checklist. Karthik here — I'll run through the PoC architecture and bring sample latency/cost profiles for a few traffic slices so we can map tradeoffs.

Attached: SSO-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet) — includes questions on identity provider, attribute mappings, session timeouts, and IP allowlist needs.

Agenda detail for the call:
- Intro & goals (Evelyn)
- Traffic profile & desired latency/cost (Samira)
- Serving runtime architecture + caching/quantization options (Karthik)
- SSO integration patterns + known network constraints (Peter)
- Procurement checklist & next steps (Monica)

Prep asks (2 items):
1) Please share the identity provider name and whether you prefer SAML/OIDC
2) Any egress/allowlist constraints (static IPs or egress ranges) so we can bring network diagrams

See you Tuesday —
Karthik Iyer
